units.source_text: 這句話時，我只是紅著臉一笑了之，並未用片言隻語去迴應。

en.t: At those words, I merely blushed and smiled, and did not answer with even a single word.

units.source_text: 然而，置身於因「被迷戀」這種粗俗的說法所產生的自鳴得意的氛圍，

en.t: Yet, when I found myself in the smug atmosphere produced by that vulgar phrase, “being adored,”

units.source_text: 實際上在心裡暗暗覺得他的話不無道理，這樣想還不及落語裡大少爺愚蠢的對白。

en.t: I was in fact secretly thinking that his words were not entirely unreasonable, but even that thought was more foolish than the lines of a pampered young master in rakugo.

units.source_text: 所以，我當然不會用輕佻嘲弄、自鳴得意的想法，去認同他的話的不無道理。

en.t: Therefore, of course, I was not agreeing that his words had some truth out of any frivolous, mocking, self-satisfied feeling.

units.source_text: 於我而言，世上的女人不知要比男人費解多少倍。

en.t: To me, the women of the world were many times harder to understand than men.

units.source_text: 我家裡的女性人數比男性多出很多，而且親戚中也是女性居多，

en.t: In my family there were far more women than men, and among my relatives as well women were in the majority,

units.source_text: 包括那些「犯罪」的女傭，把自己說成自幼是在女人堆里長大，

en.t: including those maids involved in the “crime,” so to say that I had grown up from childhood surrounded by women
would, I think, not be an exaggeration at all.
